subject: Application Received: Software Engineer II - Cloud
body:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for applying to Google. We have received your application for the Software Engineer II (Cloud Platform) role. Our recruiting team is currently reviewing your qualifications against the position requirements. We will contact you if your background aligns with our current team needs.

You can track the status of your application anytime on your Google Careers candidate dashboard.

Best regards,
Google Talent Acquisition Team

subject: Thank you for applying to Stripe
body:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for taking the time to apply for the Full Stack Engineer (Billing & Payments) role at Stripe. We have safely received your application and resume.

Our hiring managers review candidate profiles on a rolling weekly cadence. If there is a strong mutual fit, a recruiter will reach out to schedule an introductory conversation.

Cheers,
Stripe Recruiting

subject: Application Confirmation - Frontend Developer at Vercel
body:
Hi Alex,

Your application for Frontend Developer (Next.js Ecosystem) at Vercel has been submitted successfully.

We know how much effort goes into job applications, and our engineering leaders review every submission carefully. We will be in touch with updates as soon as the team completes the initial review phase.

Best,
The Vercel Team

subject: Datadog Application Acknowledged: SRE
body:
Hello Alex,

We're excited that you applied for the Site Reliability Engineer position at Datadog. This confirmation email acknowledges that we received your submission.

Our infrastructure engineering managers are currently reviewing submissions received this week. Thank you for your patience while we evaluate applications.

Warm regards,
Datadog Recruiting

subject: We got your application for Product Engineer
body:
Hey Alex,

Just confirming we received your application for the Product Engineer opening at Linear.

We build deliberately with a small, focused team, so our team reads every application personally. We expect to get back to shortlisted applicants early next week.

Best,
Linear Talent

subject: Invitation to First Round Interview - Figma
body:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for your interest in Figma! The team reviewed your background and portfolio, and we were very impressed by your frontend and component design experience.

We would love to invite you to a 45-minute technical screen with one of our Senior UI Engineers next week. Please pick a time slot that works best for you on my Calendly calendar: https://calendly.com/maya-figma-recruiting/alex-tech-screen

Looking forward to speaking with you!

Best,
Maya Lin | Senior Technical Recruiter at Figma

subject: Coding Assessment Invitation - HackerRank
body:
Hello Alex,

As the next step in our interview process for Backend Infrastructure Engineer at Airbnb, we invite you to complete a 90-minute timed coding assessment on HackerRank.

The challenge covers algorithms, data structures, and concurrent system design. Please ensure you complete the test in one sitting within 5 business days of receiving this invitation.

Assessment Link: https://hackerrank.com/x/airbnb-backend-eng-test

Best of luck!
Airbnb Engineering Hiring Team

subject: Shopify Life Story Interview Invitation
body:
Hi Alex,

Congratulations on passing our technical screening for the Ruby/Rails Backend Specialist role!

At Shopify, we value candidate journey and problem-solving mindset above all. The next step is our signature 60-minute 'Life Story' conversational interview with our Engineering Director. Please reply with your availability for this coming Thursday between 10 AM and 4 PM EST.

Best regards,
David Chen | Talent Partner @ Shopify

subject: Scheduling your Technical Architecture Interview
body:
Hello Alex,

Following up on your system design take-home submission for AI Systems Engineer, the evaluation panel gave very positive marks on your latency mitigation strategy.

We would like to schedule a 60-minute technical architecture discussion with our Claude alignment infrastructure team. Please confirm if Friday at 2:00 PM PT works for your schedule.

Warmly,
Anthropic People Operations

subject: Update regarding your application at Meta
body:
Dear Alex,

Thank you for taking the time to speak with our team regarding the Software Engineer (Product) position at Meta. Although we were impressed with your skillset and project work, we have decided to move forward with candidates whose experience more closely matches our immediate operational requirements.

We appreciate the enthusiasm you brought to the process and will retain your resume for future opportunities that match your background.

Sincerely,
Meta Global Recruiting

subject: Your application to Uber
body:
Hi Alex,

Thank you for your interest in Uber and for applying to the Mobile Developer (iOS) role. After careful review of all submissions, we have decided not to advance your application to the interview stage at this time.

Due to the large volume of applicants, we are unable to provide individualized feedback. We wish you continued success with your career search.

Best regards,
Uber Talent Team

subject: Netflix Application Status
body:
Hello Alex,

Thank you for interviewing with Netflix for the Senior Distributed Systems Engineer role. We truly appreciate the substantial time and thought you invested in discussions with our engineering leaders.

At this time, we have decided to pursue another candidate who had deeper hands-on expertise with large-scale multi-region CDN failover. We wish you all the best in your career pursuits.

Regards,
Netflix Talent Acquisition

subject: Offer Letter: Edge Systems Engineer at Cloudflare
body:
Dear Alex,

On behalf of Cloudflare, I am delighted to extend an offer for the position of Edge Systems Engineer! The team was deeply impressed with your problem-solving capabilities throughout our interview cycles.

Summary of Offer Terms:
- Annual Base Salary: $165,000 USD
- Restricted Stock Units (RSUs): $60,000 USD vesting over 4 years
- Sign-on Bonus: $15,000 USD
- Comprehensive health, dental, and remote workspace stipend

Please review the attached formal offer letter and sign through DocuSign by October 28, 2026. We can't wait to have you build a better Internet with us!

Warm regards,
Elena Rostova | Principal Talent Lead at Cloudflare

subject: Congratulations! Formal Offer of Employment - Canva
body:
Hi Alex,

It gives me immense pleasure to formally offer you the position of Full Stack Growth Engineer at Canva! Everyone on the interview loop gave glowing feedback.

Key Package Details:
- Base Salary: $150,000 AUD per annum + Superannuation
- Equity Participation Plan: 2,500 Canva Stock Units
- Flexible hybrid working arrangement and annual learning stipend

Please find your formal contract attached. Kindly confirm your acceptance by signing electronically before October 30.

Welcome to Canva!
Liam O'Connor | Engineering Recruitment Lead

subject: URGENT JOB OFFER: Remote Data Assistant (Immediate Start)
body:
CONGRATULATIONS!

You have been directly selected without interview for our high-paying Remote Data Assistant role at $65/hr ($5,200/month). Your responsibilities will be typing data into Google Sheets from home.

Before your new MacBook Pro workstation and corporate welcome kit can be dispatched to your address, company policy strictly requires all newly onboarded remote personnel to transfer a mandatory refundable security and training portal deposit of ₹4,500 ($120).

Please send this fee immediately via UPI/GooglePay to hr-apex@okaxis within 24 hours to secure your spot. Note that failing to deposit this today will immediately cancel your position.

Sincerely,
Apex Global Tech Solutions HR

subject: Exclusive Remote Work Opportunity ($800/Day)
body:

Do not reply to this email as this mailbox is unmonitored. Connect on Telegram now to claim your first bonus!

Jessica | Nexus International Trade

body:
